title: A nonnegative integer multiset with two-prime cyclotomic divisors at r distinct positive p-exponents and total weight indivisible by q has at least p to the r elements
author: Izabella Łaba; Caleb Marshall
difficulty_reason: After the classical cuboid/fibre criterion and the two-prime positive fibre decomposition of Lam--Leung Theorem 3.3, the proof still has to propagate all remaining cyclotomic divisors across successively finer congruence grids. The author uses CRT-normalized fibres to keep every one of the p smaller-grid weights indivisible by q, enabling the exponent-amplifying induction. This simultaneous multiscale preservation and positivity constraint is the concrete nonroutine obligation, so the precise Proposition 5.1 is conservatively H1.
work: Vanishing Sums of Roots of Unity and the Favard Length of Self-Similar Product Sets
